test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of June 2025, which actor-turned-politician is the Deputy Chief Minister of the state of Andhra Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pawan Kalyan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Konidela Pawan Kalyan** assumed the office of the **Deputy Chief Minister** of **Andhra Pradesh** on **June 12, 2024**, following the landslide victory of the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)** in the state.
 
• He represents the **Pithapuram Assembly Constituency**, winning the seat with a significant margin of over **70,000 votes** in the **2024 Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly elections**.
 
• As the **Deputy Chief Minister**, he has been allocated several crucial portfolios, including **Panchayati Raj**, **Rural Development & Rural Water Supply**, **Environment**, **Forest**, and **Science and Technology**.
 
• He is the founder and president of the **Jana Sena Party (JSP)**, which he established on **March 14, 2014**. In the **2024** elections, his party achieved a **100% strike rate** by winning all **21 assembly seats** and **2 Lok Sabha seats** it contested.
 
• His appointment marks a significant milestone in **Andhra Pradesh** politics, as he serves as the second-in-command to **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu**. ***Hence, the statement regarding his role as Deputy Chief Minister is correct.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jana Sena Party (JSP):** Founded by **Pawan Kalyan**, the party's symbol is the **Glass Tumbler**. The party was formed with the ideology of **social justice** and **questioning the government** on behalf of the common man. It played a pivotal role in the **TDP-JSP-BJP** alliance that secured **164 out of 175** seats in the assembly.
 
• **Chiranjeevi:** He is the elder brother of **Pawan Kalyan** and a legendary **Mega Star** of the **Telugu film industry**. He founded the **Praja Rajyam Party** in **2008**, which later merged with the **Indian National Congress**. He served as the **Union Minister of State (Independent Charge)** for **Ministry of Tourism** between **2012 and 2014**. He is not the current Deputy CM. ***Hence, this option is incorrect.***
 
• **Nandamuri Balakrishna:** A famous actor and the son of legendary actor-politician **N.T. Rama Rao**. He is a member of the **Telugu Desam Party (TDP)** and has been elected as an **MLA** from the **Hindupur constituency** for three consecutive terms (**2014, 2019, and 2024**). While he is a key figure in the ruling alliance, he does not hold the post of Deputy CM. ***Hence, this option is incorrect.***
 
• **Prakash Raj:** A versatile actor who has worked in multiple Indian languages. While he is politically active and has contested as an **Independent candidate** for the **Bengaluru Central Lok Sabha seat** in **2019**, he is not a member of the **Andhra Pradesh** cabinet or the Deputy CM. ***Hence, this option is incorrect.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Constitutional Provision:** The post of **Deputy Chief Minister** is not explicitly mentioned in the **Constitution of India** (like **Articles 163 or 164**, which mention the **Chief Minister** and **Council of Ministers**). It is a **political post** used for maintaining coalition stability or giving representation to specific communities or alliance partners.
 
• **Election Year:** The **General Elections** and **State Assembly Elections** in **Andhra Pradesh** were held simultaneously in **May 2024**. The results were declared on **June 4, 2024**.
 
• **State Capital:** Under the current government led by **N. Chandrababu Naidu**, the focus has returned to developing **Amaravati** as the sole capital of **Andhra Pradesh**, moving away from the previous government's **three-capital** proposal.
 
• **Personal Profile:** **Pawan Kalyan** was born on **September 2, 1971**. He made his acting debut in **1996** with the film **"Akkada Ammayi Ikkada Abbayi"** and has since become one of the highest-paid actors in India, known for films like **"Thammudu"**, **"Kushi"**, and **"Gabbar Singh"**.
